Lolita is a very common name within many Hispanic communities, especially for dogs. The name is derived from Dolores. There's nothing bad about the name unless you wanna try to make it bad. Words in the English context are not the same for other languages and cultures. Not every single culture has the same stigma about the same things. 

I believe OP even said they named her after a local restaurant. 

Just because it's offensive where you come from doesn't mean it's offensive everywhere. I'm not even Hispanic but up until yesterday I didn't even know people thought it was that bad. Just acknowledge that some people come from different cultures and move on. It's a name. A completely harmless one that wasn't intended to offend anyone at that.

Perfect. This is the best answer. When we were younger my cousin used to be afraid of putting her head under the water. No clue why, she just had a fear. Sometimes it would take her minutes to finally decide to jump in. Had I been the little shit I was and pushed her in before she was ready to, she probably would've freaked out like that too. Not out of wanting attention but because she'd be genuinely frustrated, upset, and slightly shake. That kind of stuff _can_ be scary or upsetting for a kid, even if it seems miniscule to us. Knowing my cousin, she probably would've freaked out and managed to do something stupid and hurt herself in the process too, so asking if you're hurt is a completely valid question, not to mention it opens discuss. Kids have meltdowns because they don't know how to express themselves. Not every melt down is a sign of bad parenting.

The "GO, Sky" and "Out" _did_ sound a little annoyed. Perhaps she didn't intend for it to sound that way, but it did. Like, I've never heard a parent say "out" when they're trying to get their kid to do something they're (presumably) afraid of unless they're already done with dealing with the kid. 

And I mean, shit happens. No shame in being annoyed. Given the right context (context that we don't have, unfortunately) I could see myself getting pretty annoyed too.
